propositions: sign_manifest's pre-sign fence compares store-wide git HEAD before/after collect() rather than the subject's own generation, causing false-positive invalidation when unrelated tickets commit during the ~3-7s collect window

under_lock_check's locked_head != expected_after comparison is anti-correlated by construction (HEAD moves precisely after lock acquisition completes), ensuring retry exhaustion under any concurrent write load
tracker_head_sha treats another writer's index-only staged entries (normal locked add→commit footprint) as store-read-failure, consuming the retry budget despite the worktree being clean
the documented recovery command rebar sign-review permanently fails for affected tickets under normal store churn, leaving them unclaimable despite a passing review
the regression test encodes the correct scope invariant but freezes tracker_head_sha to a constant, preventing the fence mechanism from being exercised and tested
